description: Source code for PDCCH (Physical Downlink Control Channel) PDU translation and processing in a 5G NR context, including functions to fill DCI and CORESET parameters and convert FAPI PDU to physical layer format.

methods.name: fill_dci
methods.description: Populates the DCI parameters of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data and precoding matrix.

methods.name: fill_coreset
methods.description: Populates the CORESET parameters of the PDCCH processor PDU based on FAPI PDU data.

methods.name: convert_pdcch_fapi_to_phy
methods.description: Converts FAPI PDCCH PDU to physical layer PDU format, filling in coreset and DCI information.
